game.title: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord

shots.caption: Power-on text: "Prepare yourself for the ultimate in fantasy games"
Opening animation: the wizard stirs his cauldron
Opening animation: smoke rises from the cauldron
Title: the smoke has formed the Wizardry logo above the wizard
Copyright, version 2.1 of 22-JAN-82: S)tart game, U)tilities, T)itle page
Wizardry Utilities: recover, transfer, backup, make scenario disk, update, names
Utilities C)hange names: "Name change - press [RET] to begin or [ESC] to exit"
Name change after Return: "Place scenario in drive 1, press Return"
Utilities T)ransfer: "Move chars between scenarios"
Transfer after Return: "Insert scenario with char(s) to be moved"
Utilities B)ackup: "Char backup (incompatible with previous version)"
Char backup after Return: "T)o or F)rom backup"
Utilities R)ecover: "Char recovery - no 10 year penalty"
Recovery after Return: "Insert scenario with 'OUT' chars"
Utilities U)pdate: "Update disk - warning - follow directions carefully"
Update step 1: punch a write-protect notch, new boot side in drive 2, old in 1
Utilities M)ake scenario disk: master in drive 2, formatted disk in drive 1
After S)tart game: "Scenario master in drv 1, press [RET]"
Second disk prompt: "Master/duplicate in drv 1, press [RET]"
Castle with no party: inn, tavern, trading post, temple, edge of town
Gilgamesh' Tavern with no party: "You may A)dd a member"
Tavern A)dd: "Who will join ?" - the name is typed
Adding JIB: "Enter password" is asked for every character
A name that is not on the roster: "** WHO? **"
A wrong password: "** THATS NOT IT **"
Evil STYX may not join good JIB: "** BAD ALIGNMENT **"
Edge of Town without a party: training grounds, castle, leave game (no maze)
Training Grounds: type a name to add, inspect or edit, "*ROSTER", or Return
"*ROSTER": the 20 characters found on the scenario disk, levels 9 to 50
A new name with a full roster: "There is no room left - try deleting"
KILLER, level 32 evil ninja from the disk: Murasama blade marked unusable (#)
SAM THE SHAM, level 50 samurai: Murasama blade, AC -7, both spell lists
ROB ">", level 34 good lord with the chevron: 758 hit points, no items
JIB, level 11 fighter: blue ribbon (#), dragon slayer, unknown ?SWORD, ?SCROLL
A new name: "That character does not exist. Do you want to create it (Y/N) ?"
Creation form: "Enter a password ([RET] for none)"
Creation: "Enter it again to be sure"
Creation: choose a race - human, elf, dwarf, gnome, hobbit
Creation: choose an alignment - good, neutral, evil (elf chosen)
Creation: the elf's scores 7 10 10 6 9 6 and 8 points to share with + and -
Three + and one - on Strength: 9, six points left
Points spent: STR 11, IQ 11, AGI 11 list A) fighter, B) mage, D) thief
Esc with no points left: "Choose a class"
Mage chosen: "Keep this character (Y/N)?"
A known name: inspect, delete, reroll, change class, set new password
The new character's sheet: ZED, neutral elf mage, 2 hit points, 170 gold
C)hange class: ZED's scores allow A) fighter and D) thief
ZED after the change: level 1 elf fighter
The price of a class change: scores back to the elf's base, age 19 to 25
D)elete: "Are you sure you want to delete (Y/N) ?"
R)eroll: "Are you sure you want to reroll (Y/N) ?"
S)et new password: "Enter new password ([RET] for none)"
Typing a known name: "Password >" before the character's options
"*ROSTER" after the clean-up: the party of six, all level 1
Castle: the party of six, level 1, and the five places to go
Gilgamesh' Tavern with a full party: remove a member, see a member
Tavern R)emove: "Who will leave ([Return] exits)"
MNZ removed: five left, A)dd a member is offered again
RYZ, level 1 good human fighter: 9 hit points, 101 gold, age 19
Adventurer's Inn: "Who will stay ([Return] exits)"
Inn rooms: stables free, cots 10, economy 50, merchant 200, royal 500 GP/week
Stables: "You need 1000 more experience points to make level"
Cots: "RYZ is healing up - hit points (6/9), gold 81" a week at a time
"You made a level! You gained strength, I.Q.; you lost piety, agility"
DEDDO makes level 2: "You learned new spells!!!!" and four scores gained
Royal suite for a level 13 fighter: hit points (63/112), gold 23817
Level 13: "You need 257878 more experience points to make level"
Edge of Town with a party: maze, training grounds, castle, leave the game
L)eave the game writes the roster: "Press [Return] for more Wizardry"
Castle with the veteran party: level 13, armour class -4 to 9
RYZ, level 13 fighter: long sword + 2, plate mail + 2, shield + 2, helm + 1
CONDI, level 13 dwarf fighter: age 47, potion of Sopic in the pack
EBO, level 13 gnome priest: priest spells 9/8/7/6/5/4/2, a helm he cannot use
CUBI, level 13 hobbit thief: short sword +2, leather + 2, scroll of Katino
DEDDO, level 13 elf mage: mage spells 9/8/7/6/5/4/2, age 63
MNZ, level 13 elf bishop: mage spells to level 4, priest spells to level 3
R)ead spell books: spells left per level, M)age or P)riest book
Known mage spells: all 21, HALITO to TILTOWAIT, grouped by level
Known priest spells (EBO): all 29, KALKI to KADORTO
T)rade: "Trade with" and the party by number
Trade with CONDI: "Amt of gold ?" comes first
Trade: "What item" - the Dios potion has gone to CONDI
D)rop: "Drop item (0=exit) ?"
Item 5 dropped: the Dios potion is gone from RYZ's pack
A cursed robe in the pack: 6)-CURSED ROBE, the "-" mark of the legend
Boltac's: "Welcome to the trading post - who will enter"
Boltac's menu for RYZ, 24817 gold: buy, sell, uncurse, identify, leave
Stock from the start: long sword 25, short sword 15 ... dagger 5
Stock F)orward: dagger, shields 20 and 40, robes 15, leather 50, chain mail 90
Stock: breast plate 200, plate mail 750, helm 100, Dios and Latumofis potions
Stock: short sword+1 15000, mace+1 12500, staff of Mogref UNUSABLE for a fighter
Stock: leather + 1 to breast plate +1 at 1500, scrolls of Badios and Halito 500
Last page: staff +2, jeweled amulet, Sopic potion, copper gloves, evil chain + 2
P)urchase: "Purchase which item ([Return] exits) ?"
Latumofis potion bought for 300: "** Just what you needed **"
CUBI (thief) picks a long sword: "Unusable item - confirm buy (Y/N) ?"
S)ell: RYZ's pack at half price, "Which do you wish to sell ?"
Dios potion sold for 250: "** Anything else, sire? **"
I)dentify: an unknown SWORD in RYZ's pack, fee 5000
Identified by Boltac: the sword is a DRAGON SLAYER
U)ncurse: the cursed robe RYZ wears, fee 4000
Uncursed: the robe is gone from the list
Temple of Radiant Cant: "Who are you helping ?" - a name is typed
A party member cannot be helped: "** RYZ is not here **"
A healthy character left at the tavern: "** CONDI is OK **"
CONDI dead, out of the party: "The donation will be 3250. Who will tithe"
RYZ pays: "Murmur - chant - pray -"
"Murmur - chant - pray - invoke! ** CONDI is well **"
CONDI back in the party after the temple: 1 of 124 hit points
CONDI in ashes: the donation is 6500
CUBI cannot pay 6500: "** Cheap apostates! Out! **"
Camp on entering the maze: reorder, equip, disband, # to inspect, leave
Floor 1 entrance: wireframe corridor, command list, party table
Walking into a wall: "OUCH!" in the view
T)ime: "New delay (1-5000)" sets how long messages stay
I)nspect searches the square for bodies: "Found: ** no one **"
Floor 1 darkness: the view stays empty
A door ahead (Werdna's, floor 10): K)ick goes through
Floor 1 (0,10): "Stairs going down. Take them (Y/N) ?"
Floor 2 arrival: "Stairs going up. Take them (Y/N) ?"
Floor 1 elevator (10,8): buttons marked A through D
After button D: DUMAPIC reports 10 east, 8 north, 4 levels below
Floor 2 (10,9): buttons on the wall marked A through D, the same elevator as floor 1's, one square north
Floor 4 elevator (10,0): buttons marked A through F
Floor 3 (0,7): "A pit!"
Floor 9 (8,2): "A chute!" drops the party to floor 10
Floor 3: a crossing of corridors
Floor 6 (8,16): doors side by side
Floor 7 (9,19): a long hall seen through openings
Floor 1 (9,12): "A large sign on the wall reads: corridor out of limits"
Floor 1 (9,19): a strange glow, a smallish man in a long robe turns and shouts
Floor 1 (13,3): a bronze statuette, body of a chicken and head of a cat
Floor 1 (13,5): a large statue of a hooded humanoid, bejeweled
Floor 2 (8,7): bronze-colored smoke, "compelled to leave the room"
Floor 2 (8,12): a silvery fog and images of terrible demons
Floor 2 (14,11): a placard near the ground: "When it's not lit..."
Floor 2 (9,18): a statuette of a bear, "I've got a million of 'em"
At the bear statuette: "Search (Y/N) ?"
Searching: "RYZ got item" (the bear statuette)
Floor 2 (12,4): a statue of a frog in a red and blue cape on a silvery disk
Floor 2 (4,11): "Nobody in the party can break the door down"
Floor 3 (0,15): "The floor has a mosaic reading: Turn left."
Floor 4 (10,14): "Testing Grounds Control Center - do not enter"
Floor 4 (10,15): a clanging of bells, then clanking and tromping
Next page: guardian monsters - "the party gets the idea ... big trouble"
Floor 4 (8,15): "A sign on the door reads: Treasure repository"
Floor 4 (12,15): "A sign on the door reads: Monster allocation center"
Floor 4 (11,11): a 10 by 10 room with a large semi-circular desk
Floor 4 (10,2): "Private elevator - authorized users only!"
Floor 4 (10,1) without the blue ribbon: "Everybody in the party passes out!"
Next page: "much weakened, the party finds themselves outside the door"
Floor 4 (17,12): a sliding wall with the image of a bear blocks the path
Floor 5 anti-magic square: DUMAPIC in camp - "** Spell fails **"
Floor 10 (0,0) after the chute: an ornate gold plaque with a message
The plaque: "ye are trespassing on the property of the arch-mage Werdna"
The plaque's clue: "Contra-dextra avenue"
Floor 10 (3,14): "One group of guardians ye have beaten ... turn back"
Floor 10 (17,4): "Lair of the evil wizard Werdna - the wizard is **in**"
Camp, inspecting DEDDO: cast spells, use an item, identify are offered here
Camp R)eorder: CONDI and RYZ placed, choosing who is third
Camp E)quip: "Select weapon for RYZ - 1) long sword + 2"
Equip, next slot: "Select armor for RYZ - 1) plate mail + 2"
Camp D)isband: "Confirm (Y/N) ?" - leaves the party in the maze
EBO casts DIOS in camp: "Cast on who"
U)se in camp: "Use item (0=exit) ?" - RYZ at 65 of 112 hit points
The Dios potion asks "Cast on who"
MNZ (bishop) I)dentify: "Identify what item (0=exit) ?" - 4)?RING
"Success!" - the ring is a RING OF PORFIC
DUMAPIC in camp: facing north, 0 east, 0 north, 1 level below the castle
MALOR: "Party teleport" - N S E W U D set the displacement
MALOR displacement set: 3 east, 2 north, 1 down
MALOR into solid rock on floor 10: "You bounced back to where you were!"
MALOR two levels up: "You materialized in mid-air and fell to a painful death!"
The roster after the fall: all six DEAD
Floor 1 (7,1): 3 Slimes; RYZ's options F)ight S)pell P)arry R)un U)se
DEDDO's order: "Spell name ?" - spells are typed, HAL so far
All orders given: "Press [Return] to fight, or go B)ack to redo options"
"CONDI thrusts at a slime and hits 1 times for 4 damage! CONDI kills one!"
"DEDDO casts a spell" (HALITO) - the spell is not named in the message
"For killing the monsters each survivor gets 27 experience points"
A chest! You may: O)pen, C)alfo, L)eave, I)nspect, D)isarm
I)nspect: "Who (#) will inspect?"
CUBI (thief) inspects the chest: "Trapless chest"
O)pen: "Who (#) will open?"
The chest opened: a pile of treasure, "Each share is worth 5 GP!"
D)isarm by CUBI: "What trap" - the trap's name is typed
Disarming a trapless chest: "The chest was not trapped"
Floor 1: 3 Skeletons, "You surprised the monsters!" (no S)pell offered)
Floor 1: 4 Slimes and 3 Small humanoids, two groups
F)ight with two groups: "Fight against group # ?"
Floor 1: 5 Small humanoids (not yet identified)
Floor 1: 2 Undead kobolds, the skeleton picture
Floor 1: 2 Scruffy men
Floor 1: 4 Bubbly slimes, identified at once, surprised
Floor 1 (13,18), the room south of the boar statue: 5 Kobolds, surprised
Entering a room: "An encounter" before the monsters appear
Floor 2: 5 Gas clouds - "The monsters surprised you!"
In the monsters' free round: "Gas cloud flees!"
"Gas cloud casts a spell - RYZ takes 3 damage"
A sleep spell that fails: "Gas cloud casts a spell - RYZ is not slept"
Floor 2 (8,12), after the silver fog: 4 Priests
Floor 3: 1 Spirit
Floor 3 (13,17) fixed fight: 4 Dragon flies; spells allowed from round 1
DEDDO's MAHALITO: "Dragon fly takes 16 damage - dragon fly dies!"
MNZ's KATINO: "Dragon fly is slept"
"Dragon fly breathes! RYZ takes 4 damage" - every member is hit in turn
EBO's BADIOS: "Dragon fly is unaffected!"
"CONDI chops at a dragon fly and hits 2 times for 26 damage! CONDI kills one!"
Round 2: one Dragon fly left of four
Floor 4 (10,14) guard room: 5 Animals and 3 Men in armor
Floor 7: 3 Lvl 6 ninjas and 5 Priests
Floor 7: 4 Medusalizards
Floor 8: four groups - Unseen entities, Lesser demon, Lvl 8 ninja, Ogre lords
MNZ's LAHALITO with four groups: "Cast spell on group #?"
"RYZ stabs at a lesser demon and hits 2 times for 13 damage!"
EBO's MALIKTO hits every group: "Unseen entity takes 52 damage - dies!"
The same MALIKTO: "Lvl 8 ninja takes 41 damage - Lvl 8 ninja dies!"
DEDDO's TILTOWAIT: "Unseen entity takes 86 damage - unseen entity dies!"
TILTOWAIT on the demon: "Lesser demon is unaffected!"
Round 2: only the Lesser demon is left of four groups
Floor 8: 2 Men in armor
Floor 8: 1 Priest and 1 Strange animal
Floor 8: 4 Master thieves
Floor 8: 4 Men in armor with the swordsman picture
Floor 8: 2 Arch mages
All six parry: "Arch mage casts a spell - MNZ takes 3 damage"
Floor 8: 3 Trolls
Floor 9: 1 Strange animal with the giant's picture
Floor 9: 3 Gaze hounds
Floor 9: 4 Wyverns, 4 Men in robes, 2 Unseen entities
Floor 9: 4 Strange animals
U)se in battle: RYZ's items by number
"Strange animal claws at EBO and hits 2 times for 7 damage - EBO is poisoned"
The Dios potion used: "RYZ casts a spell - RYZ is fully healed"
R)un fails: the animals attack, "EBO is poisoned"
R)un succeeds: the party is back in the maze without a message
Floor 9: 1 Unseen entity; EBO (priest) has D)ispell
"EBO dispells! 1 dissolves!"
A dispelled monster is worth nothing: "each survivor gets 0 experience points"
C)alfo: "Who (#) will cast Calfo?"
EBO's CALFO names the trap: "Crossbow bolt"
RYZ opens it anyway: "Oopps! A crossbow bolt"
From the chest: "CUBI found - SWORD" (unidentified)
"Each share is worth 58 GP!"
Floor 10: 3 Lvl 10 mages and 1 Man in robes, surprised
Floor 10: 1 Poison giant and 2 Will o' wisps
A level 1 party on floor 8: 4 Master ninjas and 3 Strange animals
"Master ninja slashes at RYZ and hits 2 times for 10 damage - RYZ is slain!"
"Strange animal calls for help! But none comes!"
"Strange animal calls for help! And is heard!" - the group grows to 4
Round 2: RYZ, CONDI and EBO dead, CUBI is first to give an order
Behind the door: Unseen entity, W E R D N A, Unseen entity - surprised
Orders: fight Werdna twice, MALIKTO, parry, TILTOWAIT, LAHALITO on group 2
"DEDDO casts a spell - unseen entity takes 75 damage" (TILTOWAIT)
The same TILTOWAIT: "W E R D N A takes 69 damage"
MNZ's LAHALITO: "W E R D N A is unaffected!"
"RYZ swings at W E R D N A and hits 3 times for 15 damage! RYZ kills one!"
"For killing the monsters each survivor gets 4421 experience points"
"RYZ found - AMULET" over Werdna's treasure
Werdna's room after the fight: all six unhurt
RYZ's sheet after the fight: ?AMULET, unidentified, in the pack
Another timing: 1 Vampire lord, 1 W E R D N A, 1 Vampire, named at once
"A friendly group of W E R D N A. They hail you in welcome!" F)ight or L)eave
L)eave in peace: the party stands in Werdna's room, no fight
Surprised by the monsters: "W E R D N A casts a spell - RYZ takes 104 damage"
Werdna's spell goes down the party: "EBO takes 95 damage - EBO dies!"
"Vampire casts a spell - RYZ takes 15 damage - RYZ dies!"
After the surprise round: "The vampires advance!" - four members dead
The whole party killed by Werdna: six tombstones, RIP, with the ages
MALOR home from Werdna's room: -17 east, -3 north, -9 down
Floor 1 (0,0) with the amulet: "Stairs going up. Take them (Y/N) ?"
"*** Congratulations ***": 250,000 experience points each and the chevron
The Castle after the ending: all six unequipped, armour class 10
RYZ ">" after the ending: the chevron, 4817 gold left, no items
At the inn after the ending: RYZ needs 3457 more points for level 14
"A friendly group of Spirits. They hail you in welcome!" F)ight or L)eave
Floor 3: 3 Killer wolves and 1 Dragon puppy
Floor 3: 4 Priests and 2 Lvl 4 thieves
Floor 3: 2 Gargoyles and 5 Unseen entities
Floor 3: a friendly group of Lvl 4 thieves
Floor 7: 3 Weretigers, surprised
Floor 7: Men in armor, a High priest, Champ samurai and High priests
Floor 7: 4 Champ samurai and 2 Men in robes
Floor 7: a friendly group of Major daimyos
The silver fog, next page: "Party members flee the room in terror."
CUBI types CROSSBOW BOLT: "You disarmed it!" - DEDDO found a SWORD
Geared veterans: "RYZ chops at W E R D N A and hits 2 times for 23 damage!"
"W E R D N A casts a spell - MNZ is hit by MABADI!"
"Vampire thrusts at RYZ and hits 1 times for 4 damage - RYZ is paralyzed"
The same touch: "2 levels are drained!"
Round 2: RYZ paralyzed (P-LYZE), moved to sixth place, 88 hit points left
